channel.title: Global Arbitration Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Global Arbitration Review (globalarbitrationreview.com)

item.title: Brazil’s appeal in Petrobras shareholder feud clears hurdle in Paris
item.description: A Paris court has found that Brazil can proceed with an appeal of an order enforcing an annulled partial award in a US$41 billion arbitration brought by two minority shareholders in state-run oil company Petrobras.

item.title: Gharavi will not preside over reopened Jordan Chiles case
item.description: Hamid Gharavi has said he will not continue to preside over the Jordan Chiles case for the Court of Arbitration of Sport after a Swiss court dismissed conflict of interest allegations against him on multiple grounds and reopened the merits of the case based on new evidence that emerged after the award.

item.title: Webuild brings new ICSID claim against Argentina
item.description: Italy’s Webuild has filed a new ICSID claim worth more than US$150 million against Argentina over a highway concession – as the state applies to annul an award requiring it to pay damages to the construction group over a separate project.

item.title: Port operator brings ICC claim against Panama
item.description: A subsidiary of Hong Kong-based conglomerate CK Hutchison has filed a US$2 billion ICC claim against Panama, accusing the state of attempting to seize a coveted port concession at the Panama Canal.

item.title: Ecuador boutique launches new office
item.description: Ecuadorean boutique TADIR Dispute Resolution has launched a new office in Guayaquil with the hire of partner Óscar Del Brutto from Coronel y Pérez.

item.title: Ontier hires from Freshfields in Riyadh
item.description: Ontier has recruited Lojayne Shaheen from Freshfields’ Riyadh office to the partnership.

item.title: Dutch boutique recruits from De Brauw
item.description: Enhance Arbitration – the Amsterdam boutique launched last year by the former arbitration team at Van Doorne – has hired Szilvia Nagy from De Brauw Blackstone Westbroek as counsel.

item.title: Exxon settles Colombian oil block dispute
item.description: A Canadian energy company says it has agreed to withdraw an arbitration against ExxonMobil over rights to a Colombian oil block whose permits were affected by a proposed ban on fracking.

item.title: White & Case and 3VB in place for Bangladeshi disputes
item.description: Bangladesh has turned to White & Case to defend it against an investment treaty claim by one of the country’s richest men, while a state agency has appointed a team from London barristers' set Three Verulam Buildings for a SIAC dispute with an Indian power company.

item.title: European insurers withdraw ICSID claims against Mexico
item.description: European insurance giants Allianz and AXA have discontinued ICSID claims that they filed against Mexico in response to retrospective tax demands.
